steps.what: Audition and interview performers to observe their work and understand their experience
Assess performers against specific roles and identify talent for future consideration

tasks.design: Keep auditions, interviews and assessment human, with current assessment notes in {DOCS}. No performance ranking, inferred personal attributes or automated suitability score is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Creative fit and potential emerge through actual performance and interaction rather than fixed fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native records are sufficient to retain the talent director's assessment.
tasks.still_hard: An audition is context dependent and may not reveal a performer's full range.
tasks.human_edge: The talent director interprets performance and can explore an unexpected strength through conversation.
tasks.altitude: Audition time and human assessment responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Role interpretation and contextual casting judgement

evidence.claim: Auditioning and interpreting performance requires human creative judgement; no labour saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is conducting auditions and interviews and forming an assessment, excluding contacting performers, preparing audition packs and final casting decisions. Shared assessment actions must have one owner.

Performers produce their performance and interview responses during s1, before s2 can assess them. Talent director observes and captures notes within the retained 100 hours; no free structured performance rating is assumed.
Keep native records and existing audition arrangements. No recording, model evaluation or new process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which auditions are remote versus in person
How assessments and performer records are retained and accessed
research_questions: Do audition notes distinguish observed performance from interpretation and uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Conduct auditions and interviews and form a human assessment

incremental.description: No changed process or new upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental upkeep=0. Performance observation and human assessment keep their full time; automated summaries are not substituted for auditions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify scripts, role information and casting requirements for each audition group
Assemble scripts and role and casting information into actor preparation packs
Check and provide preparation packs and explain audition requirements to actors

tasks.design: Configure audition pack templates in {DOCS} from the talent director's verified script and role references. The director checks each recipient pack, sends it through {EMAIL} and retains personal explanation and questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly assembling the same approved material for different audition groups consumed preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can collect versioned scripts and fixed instructions without interpreting casting suitability.
tasks.still_hard: Actors may need clarification and incorrect script or recipient choices can compromise an audition.
tasks.human_edge: The talent director explains expectations in a way the actor can use.
tasks.altitude: Less pack assembly; responsibility for preparation and actor communication stays human.

reach.task: Define audition material against role needs
reach.learn: Role interpretation and script version control

evidence.claim: A fixed audition pack can be assembled from checked document references and explicit instructions; the time scenario is unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is providing preparation material and explanations, excluding selecting candidates, contacting them about opportunities, scheduling auditions and evaluating performance.

Production directors provide approved role requirements and script versions through existing creative work. Talent director checks and captures audition identifier, role, script version and permitted extract, instruction text, preparation deadline, recipient list and sharing restrictions in s1's 30 hours. No free structured pack or recipient choice is assumed.

s2 assembles exact supplied material without rewriting scripts or selecting actors. Missing references, uncertain sharing permissions or different instructions return to manual preparation in s3; its 45 hours include checking, questions and exceptions.

Actors produce preparation questions after receiving the pack or during explanation in s3; they are not prerequisites for earlier assembly. Try native templates before custom code; s3 binds acceptance to exact materials and recipients.
unknowns: Whether scripts can be shared through the current document store
How often packs differ beyond explicit fields
research_questions: Can a native template assemble correct role-specific extracts without increasing checking or actor confusion?

already_counted.description: Capture pack requirements, check recipients and material, explain instructions and handle exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain pack templates and version links

approvals.approved_version: Exact preparation pack, script extracts, role requirements, recipient list and sharing restrictions; changes require renewed review before sending

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75, gross=25; minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net=18. Range assumes only repeat packs fit the template and bespoke actor preparation stays manual; no actor preparation or conversation time is saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compare suitable performers against role needs using human audition assessments
Select performers within delegated authority or submit suitable performer lists for final selection

tasks.design: Keep performer comparison and selection human, using audition assessments already retained in {DOCS}. The talent director records a choice within their authority or submits an exact recommendation for the responsible producer or director to decide.
tasks.previous_blocker: Role fit involves creative interpretation rather than stable ranking criteria.
tasks.enabler_now: Current native assessment records support the decision without automated candidate scoring.
tasks.still_hard: Performers offer different strengths that cannot be meaningfully reduced to one score.
tasks.human_edge: The talent director understands performance in relation to the role and ensemble.
tasks.altitude: Selection effort and delegated decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Choose a cast that serves the production

evidence.claim: Casting comparison and selection require human creative judgement; no task saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is casting comparison and the talent director's selection or recommendation, excluding conducting auditions, contracts, negotiations and the producer's separate final decision where required. Do not count audition assessment twice.

Audition assessors produce their notes through the separately owned audition task before s1. Talent director checks and compares them in s1 and records the exact choice or recommendation in s2; no free structured suitability score is assumed.
If final authority belongs to a producer or director, their existing decision occurs after the recommendation and is outside this focal task; no transfer or reduction of that work is claimed.
Keep native assessment records. No new model evaluation or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which roles the talent director can cast directly
What information the final decision maker needs
research_questions: Can each recommendation be traced to human observations and the role's creative requirements?

already_counted.description: Compare performers and make or submit the human casting decision

incremental.description: No changed process or new upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact performer choice or recommendation list, role version and stated rationale within delegated authority; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental upkeep=0. Human comparison and selection retain full time; no downstream decision maker saving is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify agents and actors, opportunity details and possible audition times before contact
Prepare opportunity notifications and audition time options for the selected agents and actors
Contact agents and actors, explain opportunities and agree and confirm audition times

tasks.design: Configure invitation templates in {EMAIL} and use explicit audition windows from {CALENDAR}. The talent director checks each message, makes contact and negotiates the actual time with the actor or agent before confirming it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly filling opportunity details and time options distracted from the contact and scheduling conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native invitation templates can fill verified fields without selecting performers or inferring their availability.
tasks.still_hard: Agents and actors may have questions or availability that differs from proposed times.
tasks.human_edge: The talent director builds the relationship and finds a workable arrangement.
tasks.altitude: Less notification preparation; contact and scheduling authority stay human.

reach.task: Coordinate audition availability with production needs
reach.learn: Production dependencies and clear invitation terms

evidence.claim: Native invitation templates can populate explicit opportunity details and proposed times without automating candidate choice; savings are unmeasured model scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary is notifying already human-selected contacts and arranging auditions, excluding selecting candidates, sending script preparation packs and evaluating performance. Contact selection is existing human casting work outside this task and earns no saving here.

Production staff supply existing opportunity details and audition room availability; contact records come from normal relationship records. Talent director verifies and captures contact name and address, opportunity identifier and version, role, notification text, permitted time windows, timezone, location and reply route in s1's 30 hours.

s2 only fills checked fields and proposes windows; it does not assert actor availability or book automatically. Actor or agent responses arise after the initial human contact in s3 and before its agreement and confirmation; none is required for the earlier draft.

Missing contact data, unclear timezones or changed opportunities return to manual drafting in s3's retained 50 hours. Try native templates first; each outgoing message and appointment is checked by the talent director immediately before release.
unknowns: How complete and current existing contact records are
Whether recurring invitations differ enough to require manual drafting
research_questions: Does templating reduce preparation while preserving correct opportunity details and negotiated appointment times?

already_counted.description: Capture invitation fields, check and send messages, negotiate times and handle exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain invitation templates and calendar field mappings

approvals.approved_version: Each exact outgoing notification or confirmation, opportunity version, recipient and agreed appointment details checked immediately before sending; changes require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80, gross=20; subtract 6 focal upkeep for central net=14. Range assumes only repeat invitations fit the template and all contact, actor response and negotiation time remains human; no candidate or agent time saving is claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated preparation of audition packs and notices leaves auditions, casting and personal contact fully human.
reach: Work with producers and directors on role interpretation and audition feasibility
skills_to_grow: Distinguish human performance assessment from administrative preparation
role.ambitious_version: Prepare clear, accurate auditions while keeping performer assessment, casting judgement and relationship responsibility with people.
